reasoning: On the season so far the Lakers are the stronger team; with home court the Lakers start about 14 points better, in a game of about 233 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 0 points towards the Jazz.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Jazz (revenge, streak).
Bottom line: the Lakers win 86 times in 100, by about 13; most games like this end between 208 and 256 total points.
